title: LG ThinQ Washer Cycle Failure Rate
dataSources: LG ThinQ washer cycles (`thinq:washer`), LG ThinQ dryer cycles (`thinq:dryer`), Home Connect dishwasher runs (`homeconnect:dishwasher`), and ecobee HVAC runtime (`ecobee:thermostat`).
app: LG ThinQ washer and dryer telemetry, Home Connect dishwasher data, and ecobee HVAC runtime exported into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=thinq:washer
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(cycle_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by program_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often LG ThinQ washer cycle records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each program name.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize cycle_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per program name.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It maps which parts of your LG ThinQ washer cycle data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
